title: Normalize Windows path identity keys
summary: Canonicalize Windows path comparisons used by queue manifests, library-profile matching, and audit-progress pointer validation.
reason: Windows hosted CI can expose the same directory via RUNNER~1 and its long name, which previously produced mismatched keys and false path-boundary rejections.
behavior_before: The affected helpers compared lexical path spellings, so equivalent Windows 8.3 and long paths could miss manifest entries, library profiles, or valid audit pointers.
behavior_after: The affected helpers reuse the resolved canonical path key and boundary helper, preserving case-insensitive semantics while treating equivalent Windows short and long paths as the same location.

rollback_plan: Revert this packet's four helper changes and its regression test to restore lexical path comparisons if the shared resolved path key proves incompatible with a supported filesystem.
